# Admizz Education

Dreaming of studying abroad? Admizz Education helps you explore top destinations, apply to global universities, and prepare for success- all through one global portal.

Admizz Education is a study-abroad consultancy based in Nepal, founded in 2015 by Manish K Sah (Founder & CEO, Admizz Group), with offices in Kathmandu (Opposite to Nabil Bank, Sita Ram Square, 4th Floor, Putalisadak, Kathmandu 44600) and Bengaluru (Kanakapura Main Road). Its Kathmandu office is rated 4.9 from 122 Google reviews (as of October 2026). It guides students through university selection, admissions, scholarships, student visas and test preparation. Contact: hello@admizz.com, +977-9802728444.

## Services
- [Study Abroad Consultancy in Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/study-abroad-consultancy-in-nepal): End-to-end guidance for studying abroad.
- [Visa Assistance for Study Abroad](https://admizzeducation.com/visa-assistance-for-study-abroad): Student visa assistance for the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and more — documents, mock interviews, application review.
- [Scholarship Assistance in Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/scholarship-assistance-in-nepal): Finding and applying for merit-based and need-based scholarships.
- [Career Counseling for International Students](https://admizzeducation.com/career-counseling-for-international-students): Choosing the right country, course and university.
- [Test Preparation Services in Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/test-prep): IELTS, TOEFL, GRE, PTE, SAT and Duolingo coaching.
- [University & College Partnerships](https://admizzeducation.com/universities): Partner universities and colleges.
- [Recruitment Partners](https://admizzeducation.com/recruitment-partners)

## Rule Changes for Nepali Students
Dated visa, funds and work-rule changes, each checked against an official government page and last reviewed October 2026.
- [Study abroad rule changes for Nepali students](https://admizzeducation.com/study-abroad-rule-changes): UK, Australia and Canada changes with effective dates and official sources.
- [UK Graduate visa cut to 18 months from 2027](https://admizzeducation.com/uk-graduate-visa-18-months-from-2027-nepali-students): 2 years if you apply by 31 December 2026, 18 months from 1 January 2027; fee GBP 937 plus health surcharge.
- [Australia Student visa rules from 2 October 2026](https://admizzeducation.com/australia-student-visa-changes-october-2026-nepali-students): family members cannot be included unless an exemption applies; onshore applications restricted.
